title: 1 – GENERAL
officialText:
1.1 Scope.—This standard provides minimum requirements for the design and construction of non-enlargement alterations to unit masonry in buildings constructed on or before the effective date of this local law as an alternate to RS 10–1B, not including plain or reinforced unit concrete, reinforced gypsum, or reinforced unit masonry. All new construction and enlargement alterations in and of themselves of unit masonry on new or existing foundations, not including plain reinforced concrete, reinforced gypsum, or reinforced unit masonry shall comply with reference standard RS 10–1B.

1.2 DIMENSIONS.—Unless the word "actual" is used, the dimensional requirements for masonry and for masonry units given in this standard are nominal. The measured dimensions of masonry shall be not more than 1/2 in. less than the required nominal dimensions.
